     Printed daily by the State of Iowa during the sessions of the General Assembly. An

 (The official bound copy will be available after a reasonable time upon adjournment.)

1st Day                   THURSDAY, OCTOBER 28, 2021                               1171

                JOURNAL OF THE SENATE

                            FIRST CALENDAR DAY
                             FIRST SESSION DAY
                       SECOND EXTRAORDINARY SESSION

                                  Senate Chamber
                    Des Moines, Iowa, Thursday, October 28, 2021

   Pursuant to the proclamation of the Governor, the Honorable Kim
Reynolds, convening the Eighty-Ninth General Assembly in
Extraordinary Session, the Senate was called to order at 10:11 a.m. by
the Honorable Jake Chapman, President of the Senate.

[...]

                      FINAL ADJOURNMENT

   By virtue of House Concurrent Resolution 14, duly adopted,
President Chapman declared the 2021 Second Extraordinary Session
of the Eighty-Ninth General Assembly adjourned sine die.
